product: Asana connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Asana connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The managed Asana connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest work management data such as workspaces, teams, projects, tasks, portfolios, and goals from Asana into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
